title: Records voice coach uses Settings-only picker defaults
summary: Records card voice coach pickers show Settings values read-only. Target reps no longer syncs from volumeReps on history; only Settings > Voice Coach can change the four picker values.
testFocus: Change values in Settings > Voice Coach → Records card shows same read-only pickers. Scrolling pickers on record card does nothing. Count session uses settings values. Recommendation page pickers still editable.

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main

asIs: Records card could edit voice coach pickers and sync target reps from fit volume.
toBe: Settings is sole source of truth; records display read-only defaults.
